Recent work supports testing sequence self-supervision alongside harder negatives, but does not establish that it will fix Electronics. [LMA4Rec (2023/2024)](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10313990/authors) uses learnable dropout to construct views without modifying interaction order. [NARec (2025)](https://ietresearch.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1049/aie2.70004) supports informative hard negatives while excluding same-target sequences from its global negative pool. Same-target exclusion is a useful safeguard, not proof that remaining negatives are truly negative. [SID4SRec (2026)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0950705126010221) explicitly filters semantically overlapping negatives; its category/brand features are unavailable in this task.

A practical hypothesis is one shared GRU trained with fixed BPR-max plus a lightly weighted sequence contrastive objective: two stochastic dropout passes preserve item order exactly; exclude duplicate histories and same-training-target examples from contrastive negatives. This is a proposed adaptation, not a demonstrated GRU4Rec result. Include an augmentation-only control: [WWW 2024’s component study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11136) found that some augmentations matched or exceeded contrastive methods, so improvements cannot automatically be attributed to contrastive separation.

Mean embedding alignment alone does not establish collapse. [SPMRec (2023)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.11986) studies degeneration through singular spectra, while [ICLR 2025 work](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/hash/2d2f85c0f93e69cf71f58eebaebb5e8d-Abstract-Conference.html) distinguishes alignment from uniformity. For the proposed experiment, inspect centered feature singular values/effective rank, feature and item norms, cosine distributions, and positive–negative score margins. Measure history dependence through shuffled-history and last-item-only inference ablations. Select using the fixed four-category macro validation HR@10; retain one GRU checkpoint per category.
